title: annotateUnitFiles
responsibility: Gives each generated source file the uid of its own new unit.

inputs.name: annotateUnitFiles.files
inputs.description: The planned files to process in one scaffold. Paths under tests/, test/, or db/, paths containing .test. or .spec., paths ending in .types.ts, and paths beginning src/models/adapters/ are returned unchanged; other paths are annotated with a unit uid.

inputs.name: annotateUnitFiles.root
inputs.description: The project root is joined with each eligible file path to check for an existing file. If a target exists on disk, its uid is reused; otherwise a new uid is minted.

outputs.name: annotateUnitFiles
outputs.description: Returns one planned entry for each input file in the original order. Excluded paths are returned unchanged; other paths have contents annotated with the existing on-disk uid when present, or a minted uid otherwise.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem error from readFileSync propagates if an existing target cannot be read.
